template.label: Mail, then call, then email
template.description: A postcard through Lob, a call from your team once it lands, then a follow-up email and a last note. Works with a list you scanned or imported, or with u9itus's directory. You write the postcard and email; nothing is sent until the cadence runs.
notes: Same timing as campaigns/u9itus-hybrid-local (docs/MAILER_FOLLOWUP_CALLS.md): postcard, a call 2 days after Lob reports delivery (10 days after sending if it doesn't), an email 3 days after the call is logged, a last note 5 days later.
Uses Lob direct mail, which costs money per piece: only a Super Admin, or someone a Super Admin allowed (console: lob allow --email … --allow true), can make a campaign from this template.
Lists from Scan a mailing list (/p/list-scan) or the import_scanned_list tool go in after the campaign is made. People with no phone get the follow-up email instead of a call.

placeholders.[[name]]: Filled once, when a campaign is made from this template, from params below.
placeholders.{{name}}: Filled per person at send time (core/pipeline.py _build_variables): contact_first, contact_name, org_name, your_name, your_email.

params.name: call_goal
params.label: What the follow-up call should get
params.default: Confirm the postcard arrived and get permission to email the details

mail_00_postcard.back:
Hi {{contact_first}},

[[postcard_message]]

[[link]]

We'll give you a quick call in a few days.
— {{your_name}}, {{your_email}}

phone_00_mailer_followup.title: Mailer Follow-Up — Did the postcard arrive?
phone_00_mailer_followup.email_body:
Hi {{contact_first}},

We mailed you a postcard last week, "[[postcard_headline]]". In case it didn't reach you:

[[email_message]]

[[link]]

{{your_name}}
phone_00_mailer_followup.body:
── BEFORE YOU DIAL ──────────────────────────────────────

[Contact: {{contact_name}}]
[The postcard said: "[[postcard_headline]]"]
[Link on the postcard: [[link]]]

── OPENING ──────────────────────────────────────────────

"Hi, is this {{contact_name}}? This is {{your_name}}. We mailed you a postcard
last week, "[[postcard_headline]]". Did it make it to you?"

[If no: "No problem. Could I email you the details instead? What's the best address?"]

── GOAL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

[[call_goal]]
[Log: interest high or medium, and the next step.]

── IF NOT ───────────────────────────────────────────────

"Understood, thanks for your time."
[If they ask not to be called: log "Asked not to be called again".]

02_last_note.subject: Re: [[email_subject]]
02_last_note.body:
Hi {{contact_first}},

One last note so this doesn't get lost: [[link]]

If it's not for you, no need to reply. I won't follow up again.

{{your_name}}
